json_ld_descriptions: AMS Law Group Car and Truck Accident Lawyers is a personal injury law firm serving accident victims throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth area with offices in Richardson and Dallas, TX.

At AMS Law Group, your legal needs are expertly handled. Our Richardson personal injury lawyers are compassionate and dedicated, providing comprehensive representation for your personal injury matters. We represent people injured in a variety of situations: motor vehicle (e.g., car, truck, taxi, Uber, Lyft, bicycle, motorcycle, etc.) or pedestrian accidents, brain injury, slip-and-fall, trip-and-fall, and burn injury, as well as wrongful death and premises liability. Above all, we're here for you. When you work with us, you gain full access to our team, knowledge, resources, and experts. Whether through skilled negotiation or dedicated trial advocacy, we work tirelessly to prepare your case and fight for the best outcome.

At AMS Law Group, our Dallas personal injury lawyers provide dedicated, compassionate representation for accident victims. From car, truck, and rideshare collisions to slip-and-fall incidents, catastrophic injuries, and wrongful death claims, our trial-ready team fights tirelessly to secure the full compensation you deserve. When you work with us, you gain direct access to our full team, resources, and legal expertise every step of the way.
